subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo for Acme Retail — timezone options
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-retail.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Planning demo — Redwood inference for Acme Retail (timezone options)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We'd love to schedule a 40–45 minute demo focused on:
- inference latency/cost tradeoffs for high-throughput storefront queries
- privacy options (VPC/on-prem) for our EU customers
- model rollouts and rollback behavior under load

Our core product team in Seattle (PST) prefers mornings between 08:00–10:30 PST. We realize your engineering leads are in Amsterdam/CET and that may push things into the evening for them.

Are you able to run through a few times that would work for the Redwood EU team? If not, a recorded walkthrough + live Q&A could also work — just want to avoid a 2am join for anyone.

Attached is a short doc with the priority checklist (acme-demo-ask.docx).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Harris
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Retail
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-retail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 00:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Planning demo — Redwood inference for Acme Retail (timezone options)

Hi Tom — thanks for the checklist and the timing guidance.

On Fri, Feb 26, 2027 at 3:00 PM Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-retail.com> wrote:
> Our core product team in Seattle (PST) prefers mornings between 08:00–10:30 PST.

Totally get it. A couple pragmatic options that won't force anyone to join in the middle of the night:

1) Live-demo overlap (recommended) — 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET (45 min)
   - Redwood AE (me) + Solutions Engineer (Markus) join from Amsterdam for the main demo.
   - We can keep the first 30 min walkthrough focused, then open to Q&A and live troubleshooting.

2) Early hybrid — 07:30 PST / 16:30 CET (30–40 min)
   - Slightly earlier for Seattle but keeps EU folks from staying very late.

3) Split delivery — 30 min pre-recorded deep-dive (shared before the meeting) + 30 min live Q&A at a shorter overlap (08:30 PST / 17:30 CET).

Notes about daylight saving: US clocks move forward on March 14, 2027. That will temporarily shift the PST/CET offsets for a few weeks until Europe changes. If the demo is after March 14, we should explicitly lock the time and include timezone-offsets in the calendar invite (e.g., 09:00 America/Los_Angeles / 18:00 Europe/Amsterdam) so invites don't auto-shift incorrectly for participants in other regions.

I've attached a short draft deck to walk through (redwood-demo-deck-v1.pdf) and a Calendly link if you want to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/lauren-demo-30m

Which of the three above would you prefer? Happy to book 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET now and we'll thread in a pre-record option for stakeholders who can't attend.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +44 20 7123 4567
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Planning demo — Redwood inference for Acme Retail (timezone options)

Lauren / Marissa — quick internal note on coverage:

- I can join live for the 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET slot. I have availability until 19:30 CET.
- If we do the split delivery option, I can pre-record a 12–15 minute technical deep-dive (covers batching, KV cache, and routing policies) and then join the live Q&A segment.
- For demos that touch on private deployments, I'd like to have our security engineer on standby; they can dial into the last 10–15 minutes if any deep compliance questions come up.

Attachment: runbook-handoff.txt (stub) — short checklist for handing off to on-call if a follow-up technical session is needed.

Let me know which live option you booked and I'll mark calendar and prepare the short recording just in case.

— Markus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-retail.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-retail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning demo — Redwood inference for Acme Retail (timezone options)

Lauren — thanks for the fast follow-up and the clear options. The team reviewed and we prefer option #1: 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET (45 min).

Can you please:
- Send a calendar invite with both time zones explicitly noted (America/Los_Angeles and Europe/Amsterdam)
- Include the pre-read (redwood-demo-deck-v1.pdf) and the checklist we attached; we'll circulate internally
- Add a brief post-demo 30-min office-hours slot the next day for any technical deep-dive (we might take you up on that for private deployment questions)

If the invite shows up as 10:00 on some calendars (DST weirdness), I'll flag it — but please lock the timezone strings as you suggested.

Best,
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Retail
